messages:
Jordan (Partnerships): Quick sync — reseller partner A wants a co-sell POC next week. They need a joint architecture diagram, cost estimate for 3 months, and answers to their security questionnaire. Can we align owners?

Elaine (Sales): Thanks. Primary asks from their IT: SSO, data residency, and whether logs contain customer PHI. Also pricing - they want a ballpark for dedicated vs hosted for ~200k tokens/day.

Sam (Solutions): I can draft the architecture and run a perf estimate. Need to know expected peak RPS and which model family they want (llama-2/guanaco/etc.). Also, are they expecting private deployment or using our hosted API via partner reseller?

Jordan (Partnerships): Partner prefers hosted for speed but will consider Dedicated if cost/policy requires. Peak ~25 RPS, avg payload 600 tokens, burst to 50 RPS. Model preference: open-model family, want quantized 4-bit if possible.

Mike (Eng-Platform): 25 RPS @ 600 tokens -> rough tokens/day checks: 25*600*3600*... wait simpler calc: they'll send ~200k tokens/day (matches Elaine). For throughput, Dedicated pool with 1-2 A100 equivalent should handle it with batching; hosted will be auto-routed but cost higher. I can prepare a config snippet for the POC infra.

Mike (Eng-Platform): ```yaml
service: redwood-dedicated
pool:
  gpu_type: a100-40gb
  count: 1
model:
  name: open-quant-4bit
  max_tokens: 4096
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 3
routing:
  fallback: hosted-compat
``` 

Anna (Security): Heads up: partner is in EU, they need EU data residency and want our SOC2 report + encryption-at-rest details. Also: confirm we don't log full inputs by default — only metadata and debug logs if enabled. Need to fill their questionnaire (I'll take the security section).

Sam (Solutions): I can tag answers for architecture and ops. Jordan / Elaine, can you share the partner's short questionnaire PDF/email thread? I'll extract the technical Qs.

Jordan (Partnerships): Shared in DM and uploaded to the deal record: link https://redwood.atlassian.net/issue/POC-4321 (private). Elaine to confirm pricing banding to include in the doc.

Elaine (Sales): For pricing ballpark: Hosted: $0.018 per 1k tokens (example), Dedicated: committed capacity $12k/month + consumption. I'll put exact tiers and a few scenarios (monthly cost for 200k/day) by EOD.

deploy-bot: Deployment request created for "reseller-poc-arch-draft" — id dpl-202303. Logs will be visible in Console > POCs.

Anna (Security): Also: partner requires KMS integration + customer-managed keys. We support KMS in Private; for Hosted we can offer envelope encryption with BYOK in Dedicated. I'll list residual risks in the questionnaire.

Sam (Solutions): To keep the POC light, propose: 2-week POC on hosted with prefix caching + token budget analysis, then optional Dedicated pilot if they want BYOK/KMS. Doc draft incoming.

Jordan (Partnerships): Awesome — owners: Sam (architecture + POC plan), Anna (security questionnaire), Mike (perf estimate + deployment config), Elaine (pricing + commercial). I'll run a call with partner Wed 10am PT. Everyone OK?

Elaine (Sales): OK for Wed 10am PT. :thumbsup:

Mike (Eng-Platform): I'll be there. Will bring latency/cost numbers.

Anna (Security): I'll join to cover compliance items.

Sam (Solutions): Got it. I'll bring sample dashboards and a short demo script.

Jordan (Partnerships): Thanks team — I'll send calendar invite and attach the draft docs before EOD. /end
